title: What Keeps the Sun Glowing Day After Day?

post_description: The Sun's secret power source, explained in plain words. Sources: National Aeronautics and Space Administration https://science.nasa.gov/sun/facts/ and European Space Agency https://sci.esa.int/web/education/-/36828-stellar-processes-and-evolution #Science #ScienceFacts #QuantaTale
narration: What keeps the Sun glowing day after day? Right in the middle of the Sun, it is hot enough for fusion. In fusion, tiny bits squash together to make something bigger. In the Sun, the simplest version turns hydrogen into helium. Here's the cool part: the new helium weighs a little less than the hydrogen. The missing bit is set free as energy. That energy matters a lot, because most life on Earth needs it.
